status: PROPOSAL ONLY — not applied to broker-config.json; human picks
note: Second upstream candidate: Google Gemini via its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The existing broker (integrations/research_budget.py) is upstream-agnostic (generic OpenAI-style chat/completions forwarding); no code change was needed to point it at Gemini beyond confirming reasoning_effort is accepted there too. Same receipts/reservation/fail-stop/ledger mechanism as the xAI configs.
model_note: The user said 'Gemini 3.8 Flash'; confirmed as the newest Flash model id via https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, fetched 2026-09-24. Re-verify against a live /v1beta/openai/models listing before the probe, since this was not itself queried live.
reasoning_effort_note: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai, fetched 2026-09-24: the OpenAI-compat endpoint accepts a top-level reasoning_effort ('minimal'|'low'|'medium'|'high'|'none' for 2.5-class models) using the SAME field name the broker already forces into every request. A separate extra_body.google.thinking_config.thinking_level/include_thoughts path also exists for thought summaries, but docs say it and reasoning_effort 'can't be used at the same time' — not used here since reasoning_effort alone is sufficient and needs no broker payload-schema change.
price_source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, fetched 2026-09-24: gemini-3.8-flash standard paid tier is $0.75 input / $3.75 output per million tokens through 2026-12-31 (rises to $1.50/$7.50 on 2027-01-01); thinking tokens are billed as output tokens, already included in that output price (no separate reasoning rate). This proposal applies the same 10% conservative markup used elsewhere in this run (0.75*1.1=0.825, 3.75*1.1=4.125).
